recognize_zh: 高倍可見真皮淺層血管周圍一團中型淋巴球，細胞核不規則、染色質較開、比周圍小淋巴球大，屬異型 T 細胞浸潤；配合 HTLV-1 陽性即支持 ATLL 侵犯皮膚。
features: Well-circumscribed perivascular aggregate of medium-sized lymphoid cells in the superficial dermis
Nuclei larger than admixed small lymphocytes, with irregular/indented contours and vesicular chromatin
Scattered small mature lymphocytes and occasional melanophages in the papillary dermis
Overlying epidermis with compact orthokeratosis; no Pautrier-type microabscess evident in this field
describe_en: H&E section of skin at higher power shows a superficial dermal perivascular aggregate of atypical medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours, open chromatin and scant cytoplasm, admixed with a few small mature lymphocytes. Scattered pigment-laden macrophages are present in the papillary dermis. The overlying epidermis shows compact orthokeratosis without conspicuous epidermotropism in this field. Findings are consistent with a cutaneous atypical T-cell infiltrate and, with HTLV-1 positivity, with involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: MF typically shows prominent epidermotropism with cerebriform cells in Pautrier microabscesses; overlap with ATLL is resolved by HTLV-1 testing.
T-PLL cells are small-to-medium with a single visible nucleolus and are TCL1-positive, CD25-negative.
Reactive perivascular lymphocytes are small and round without the nuclear enlargement and irregularity seen here.
